entries.subject: DAMIT 1853: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-1853.txt. Model 1853, version 2017-09-21, pole (98°, -52°), period 8.09068 h match the retained metadata. The archive diameter field is 93 ±10 km; its applicability to our scale is a separate calibration decision. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: AKARI thermal diameter as an alternative scale
entries.finding: [AKARI AcuA](https://data.darts.isas.jaxa.jp/pub/akari/AKARI-IRC_Catalogue_AllSky_AcuA_1.0/) — retained for comparison; the selected archive model has a physical size calibration. Its fitted nonrotating-sphere diameter is 83.11 ± 0.94 km. Formal catalog error omits additional shape, spin and thermal-model effects; no total confidence interval is invented. The original catalogue row for asteroid 72 was retrieved again and matched field-for-field with the retained row, including diameter, reported error and detection count.
entries.revisitWhen: A source-specific comparison with the selected shape and physical calibration justifies changing the adopted scale.

entries.subject: Resolved-model publication supporting DAMIT 1853
entries.finding: The live DAMIT model-to-reference export binds selected model 1853 to Adaptive optics and lightcurve data of asteroids: twenty shape models and information content analysis (2017). That publication supports the selected reconstruction. The imported entry conflated three surveys; listing them together did not establish three usable models or a registered reflectance mosaic.

entries.subject: Shape and spin alternatives
entries.finding: Alternative archive solutions: model 646, pole ['102', '-55'], [Model 646](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/asteroid_models/view/646) The live DAMIT export lists these other models for this target: 646: pole (102°, -55°), 8.09068 h, version 2013-02-11, archive diameter 74 km. These are archive alternatives, not necessarily newly released models or preferred replacements. Comparing their source methods and any pole-specific calibration remains necessary before changing the selected mesh.
entries.revisitWhen: A released numerical replacement or independent pole/size constraints that distinguish the recorded alternatives, followed by comparison against the currently selected model.
